image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two stacked Apple iPods (likely Classic models) on a dark reflective surface. The top iPod has a red metallic casing with a white click wheel; the bottom one is blue/silver with an illuminated screen showing a menu interface. White charging cables and power adapters are scattered around the devices.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is blurred and illegible, lacking sharp character definition. While common in AI generation, it fails to render crisp UI text.
The white accessories in the foreground appear melted and fused. The cable connections lack clear mechanical logic, with plugs merging into sockets indistinctly.
The reflection on the red casing is slightly uneven and 'smudged' rather than having the crisp, linear specular highlights expected from brushed metal or polished plastic.
The stacking of the two devices looks slightly physically unstable; the edges don't align perfectly parallel, suggesting minor geometric warping.

To detect fusion artifacts where cables merge with adapters or the table surface, a common failure mode in AI-generated electronics.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the UI text on the display screen.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the white accessories in the foreground. AI often struggles with thin, complex geometries like cables and plugs, resulting in 'melting' or impossible connections.
